effective_configuration.call_policy: embedding export lookup, integer argument/result marshalling and result allocation included; every result verified outside timed batch
effective_configuration.compile_policy: explicit Wasmer compiler; fresh compilation store and eager module compilation; engine creation excluded; instance creates a fresh store from the same engine
effective_configuration.native_code_policy: Optional SDK C ABI getter delegates to public sys_artifact/finished_function_extents; complete defined-function coverage required; excludes call trampolines; serialized artifact bytes are not reported as native code
effective_configuration.release_policy: native instance/store disposal; no physical RSS reclamation claim
effective_configuration.reset_policy: fresh lifecycle instance; stateless steady retained instance; wasm3 recompiles outside first-call timing
effective_configuration.vector_policy: Fresh instance per ordered vector sequence; input writes and exact output verification excluded from sum of timed export lookups, integer marshalling and embedding calls; one operation per complete sequence; lifecycle windows match scalar API phases
effective_configuration.wasmi_dispatch: not applicable; external SDK build identity pinned

description.phase_release_policy: release native instance; compiled module/engine retained except compile samples; no RSS reclamation claim
